_widening_note: No supported widening exists for this environment, so the search space is unchanged. Evidence: crash_analysis.py:66-73 declares the complete knob set (sig_frames KNOB_INT 0..4, use_exception KNOB_BOOL, use_access KNOB_BOOL) and run() reads only these three config keys (crash_analysis.py:101-103), so any additional knob would be a phantom the env never consumes. sig_frames cannot go above 4 meaningfully: mock:parser crash stacks carry at most 3 frames (mock.py:95,102,109,116,123,136 symbol lists; diagnostics.py:61-62 builds one frame per symbol), so frames=4 already captures every stack and _signature slices defensively (crash_analysis.py:26-27). No similarity-threshold mechanism exists to expose: _signature composes exact-match string parts (crash_analysis.py:24-33). The collapse guardrails are kept byte-identical. Id intentionally NOT bumped (stays -v1): per the bump rule, a fresh knowledge base is warranted only when the search space changes; here it does not, so lineage with the existing -v1 KB is preserved.
objective: Maximize accurate crash deduplication while minimizing false merges and false splits

constraints.description: Distinct vulnerabilities must not be collapsed
Equivalent crashes should normally be grouped

search_space.note: Declarative mirror of the env knob domains; unchanged - the domain is fully enumerated and partially constraint-disqualified, not under-declared.
